header.title: STRATEGY ARCHITECTURE
header.description: Our algorithmic framework is built on a multi-layered approach to market analysis. By combining mathematical indicators with dynamic exit logic, we create resilient strategies that adapt to shifting market regimes.

sections.title: Common Indicators
sections.intro: Indicators serve as the sensory organs of an algorithm. They filter raw price data into actionable signals, allowing the system to distinguish between random noise and significant market moves.
sections.philosophy: A signal is only as good as the context it exists in. We use EMA for trend direction, VWAP for value, and SMI for timing—creating a triple-confirmation entry system.

items.label: VWAP
items.name: Volume Weighted Average Price
items.description: Provides the 'true' benchmark price by incorporating volume, essential for institutional-grade value assessment.

items.label: Momentum
items.name: Momentum Based Entry
items.description: Identifies the velocity of price changes to enter trades where the trend strength is highest.

items.label: LinReg Slope
items.name: Linear Regression Slope
items.description: Measures the rate of change of a best-fit line, quantifying the intensity of the current trend.

items.label: SMI
items.name: Stochastic Momentum Index
items.description: Offers a cleaner, less noisy version of traditional stochastics for overbought/oversold detection.

items.label: EMA
items.name: Exponential Moving Average
items.description: Prioritizes recent data, ensuring the algorithm stays responsive to immediate market shifts.

items.name: Take Profit
items.description: Binary execution at a fixed mathematical target. Ensures capital is realized before mean reversion occurs.

items.name: Stop Loss
items.description: The ultimate risk circuit breaker. Hard-coded exits to prevent catastrophic drawdown during black swan events.

items.name: Slope Curvature Reversal
items.description: Exits by detecting the 'rounding' of a trend (second derivative change) before price actually reverses.

items.name: Higher Timeframe Reversal
items.description: A top-down safety check. If the macro trend shifts, the micro position is liquidated immediately to maintain alignment.

items.name: Fixed Time Exit
items.description: Eliminates 'time risk' by closing positions after a specific duration, regardless of PnL status.

items.name: Volatility-Adjusted Time Exit
items.description: Uses stochastic math to calculate expected trade duration. If the trade stagnates while volatility drops, it exits early.

sections.title: Advance Strategies
sections.subtitle: Variable Position Sizing & Dynamic Volatility Exits
sections.description: The most sophisticated layer of our engine. It doesn't just manage time or price—it manages exposure. As market volatility fluctuates, the algorithm dynamically scales the position size (Beta-weighting) while simultaneously shifting the time-based exit parameters.
